purpose: Teach: 名画/切なく/点滅/水温/霜/躾/隠せ/家出

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、美術館の、絶対、名画、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、見せたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I really do want to show you the masterpieces at the museum someday.
lines.style: Warm, deliberate opening. Gentle reach across the words. Patient, like she's making a promise she intends to keep. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お別れ、絶対、切なく、絶対、感じるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really do feel something sad about saying goodbye.
lines.style: Soft and small. Honest without performance. A pause before the harder words. The vulnerability of a child trusting an adult to hear what he's really saying.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家の電気、絶対、点滅、絶対、修理したわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I fixed the light switch in our house, so it won't flicker anymore.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Quiet pride in the doing. No fuss—just the practical care of someone who noticed something broken and fixed it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お風呂の、絶対、水温、絶対、ちょうどいいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the bath water is exactly the right temperature today.
lines.style: Bright observation, like he's noticing something small and good. Small smile in the voice. The pleasure of small comforts noticed and shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今朝、本気で、絶対、お庭、絶対、霜、絶対、降りていたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: This morning there was frost all over the garden, you know.
lines.style: Quiet noticing. Like she's thinking out loud, sharing what she saw. Soft wonder at the small beauty of a winter morning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ママの、絶対、躾、絶対、しっかり、絶対、守ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm keeping all the things Mama taught me. I'm doing my best.
lines.style: Serious with pride underneath. A child wanting her to know he's trying hard. Steady voice, not looking for praise but hoping she sees the effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、悲しみを、絶対、隠せ、絶対、ない、絶対、時、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、お話しなさいね
lines.en: Sho, when you're sad and you can't hide it anymore, you have to tell me, okay?
lines.style: Tender firmness. Not a question—a quiet instruction wrapped in care. Slow. She means every word. The weight of someone who loves him saying: you don't have to carry that alone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、家出、絶対、なんて、絶対、考えないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I would never run away from home. I promise you that.
lines.style: Quiet and certain. No doubt in the voice. A child making a solemn promise to someone he trusts completely. Finality wrapped in gentleness.
